baseline.observation: The regression was injected into target-tauri, but cargo test was invoked from the Fieldwork repository root. Cargo exited because no Cargo.toml existed there, so target behavior was never exercised.

candidate.observation: The job stopped at git apply before cargo test. candidate.patch declared a 19-line old / 28-line new hunk but contained 24 old / 33 new lines, so git reported a corrupt patch at EOF.

disposition: Do not treat either job as target evidence. Correct the patch hunk header, run cargo from target-tauri, and require the baseline failure to contain the exact regression assertion before accepting a baseline/candidate comparison.
